# v0.10.0b7 — Every shared fact has one owner

- **Breaking:** money uses Home Assistant's currency instead of fixed euros. The cost target, both cost sensors and the price fields follow it, and a price sensor must name that currency per kWh or MWh.
- **Breaking:** a wallbox without a serial-number register no longer gets a unique ID made from its port or address. Remove such an entry and set it up again.
- **Breaking:** the app alone keeps the target time. Home Assistant stores no copy any more, so a time can only be set while the app is reachable.
- **Breaking:** everything named `timed_*` is now `departure_*`. A vehicle list saved with the old option names is not valid any more: set your vehicles up again. The target time entity gets a new unique ID; delete the old, unavailable one first.
- **Breaking (service API):** a command takes only its own fields, and a value that is not permitted is refused with the error's name.
- One account of the plug-in decides for Plug & Charge, guest charging, the unplug rule and the estimates whether a car is connected.
- The app and Home Assistant name the targets alike: energy target, cost target, vehicle charge target and target time. The Charging page sorts them by whom they apply to.
- Fixes: a reconnect no longer ends a Plug & Charge grant on a wrong clock, and a target time changed while a guest charges stays as changed.

Update the app and the integration to **0.10.0b7** together. Nothing here is tested on real hardware yet.

Every contribution is voluntary and very welcome; support and new features stay open to everyone either way.
